heard: Old King David could not get warm Servants searched for a young girl They found Abishag of Shunem She served him with gentle care Adoniah claimed he would be king He took chariots and horsemen Fifty men ran ahead of him But the kingdom was not his As for Abishag as your wife This request hides a deadly claim Solomon sees through the veil of lies The throne is not yours to claim Said, okay, Nathan and I
